patches.why: STRUCTURAL RECOVERY, read at the plate 2026-09-16 (prep spot check). Migne sets a display heading above this work and Corpus Corporum drops the whole line; our TEI body opened at CC's own catalogue title, which Migne does not print. Same class as the five Glossa Pentateuch book-title lines (Wilson's ruling 2026-09-06), encoded by the same convention: <head type="book-title"> above the first head, before the first column mark, so col is null. Witness: Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w, map f = (column + 1) / 2 (corners read FIRST: f6 = 11/12, f13 = 25/26, f15 = 29/30, f17 = 33/34, f18 = 35/36); this heading on f15 (cols 29/30). Transcribed with ae for the ligature as the TEI does; Migne's capitals, small capitals and italics are not encoded.
